name: What is included in a Zen Tiny Homes tiny-home shell?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a Zen Tiny Homes tiny-home shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zen Tiny Homes tiny-home shells typically include the structural framing, exterior sheathing, weather barrier, roofing, exterior siding, and windows and doors installed. The foundation, whether a custom trailer or a permanent base, is also part of the shell package. Our shells are designed to be weather-resistant and secure, ready for your interior finishing work. Specific inclusions can be discussed during the design consultation to match your project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our tiny-home shells include framing, exterior sheathing, weather barrier, roofing, siding, windows, doors, and the foundation (trailer or permanent).
